evidence.observation: Monotonic rise to 33.2 ppm during growth (13.2, 19.4, 27.1, 33.2)
MFC flow steady at ~100 sccm matching setpoint, so the rise is not from low purge flow
Pressure steady ~761 Torr; no rise, so exhaust blockage is unlikely
Temperature holding at 750 °C with normal heater power

args.missing_evidence: A leak check (e.g., pressure-hold or helium sniff at the flanges and fittings) to confirm a seal leak; there is no reference distribution to compare against for normal O2 during growth.
